exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI (overweight and obese vs. normal weight)
cohort: 110 preterm infants born to overweight (n=68) and obese (n=42) mothers at gestational age 28-34 weeks, and 110 controls matched for gestational age and birth weight
finding: While obese and overweight mothers experienced more complications during pregnancy, preterm infants born to these mothers showed no increased risk for neonatal complications compared to infants born to mothers with normal pre-pregnancy BMI.
